blocks.text: NEW ORLEANS— Jalen Green scored 25 points, Devin Booker added 22, and the Phoenix Suns defeated the New Orleans Pelicans, 123-119 in overtime in the NBA on Monday night. Collin Gillespie scored five of his 18 points in overtime, and Miles Bridges had 13 points and 11 rebounds for Phoenix, which won its fourth straight game while handing New Orleans its fourth straight loss.
